name_en: WQ101 Alpha17 Close / Relative Volume Rank
name_zh: WQ101 Alpha17 收盘相对成交量排名
formula_zh: -rank(收盘10期时序排名)*rank(收盘变化的变化)*rank(成交量/20期均量的5期排名)
intuition_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 24h bars.
intuition_zh: 源自WQ101论文的Alpha公式，适配24小时K线。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Direction intentionally left conditional to avoid post-hoc fitting. Empirical diagnostics required.

known_limitations_en: Triple rank product mixes close rank, close acceleration, and relative volume; sparse histories need warmup review.

horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 24 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
